name: Prototype Omnitrix
description: The original, unfinished Omnitrix that latched onto ten-year-old Ben's wrist. A chunky grey-and-black wristband with a large circular faceplate; press the button and the dial pops up, twist to cycle glowing alien silhouettes, slam it down to transform.
features: Ten starter DNA samples, more unlocked over the summer
Green active mode / red recharge mode / yellow capture mode
Master Control unlocked briefly by Ben; Self-Destruct Mode; Quick-Change; Recalibration
notes: Also called the 'Original Omnitrix' by the franchise; the same physical device later reconfigures into the Alien Force form.

name: Recalibrated Omnitrix
description: The same Omnitrix, reconfigured five years later into a sleeker black, green and silver wristwatch. The round green face displays a holographic image of the selected alien; the hourglass symbol became the standard Omnitrix badge on Ben's aliens.
features: New default playlist of ten aliens with the older set locked
Holographic alien selection instead of silhouettes
Voice command mode; DNA repair function (cured DNAliens)
Master Control briefly used in War of the Worlds; destroyed in The Final Battle

name: Ultimatrix
description: Albedo's incomplete evolutionary Omnitrix, claimed by Ben at the end of Alien Force. Larger and more gauntlet-like, black and green, with a four-lobed hourglass dial that Ben twists to evolve a transformation into its Ultimate form.
features: Evolutionary function: 'Ultimate' forms simulating a million years of worst-case evolution
Full alien roster of the recalibrated Omnitrix plus new unlocks
Voice command mode; can be controlled by Ben's mind after synching
Removed by Azmuth after The Ultimate Enemy
notes: The Ultimatrix's Ultimate forms were sentient during the Ultimate Alien season-3 'Sentient Ultimates' storyline.

name: Omnitrix (Omniverse)
description: Azmuth's completed Omnitrix — the real thing, not a prototype. A slim white-and-green wristwatch with black accents; the dial's green core projects a hologram of the selected alien, and the faceplate slides open to reveal the activation core.
features: Complete Codon Stream access; new randomizer / master control functions
Feedback restored, Ultimate forms removed (they belong to the Ultimatrix)
Life-form lock, remote transformation and other Galvan security features
Worn throughout Omniverse, including the 'eleven-year-old Ben' flashbacks (with the prototype)

name: Biomnitrix
description: Ben 10,000's twin-Omnitrix system worn on both wrists; slamming them together fuses two aliens into one.
features: Fusion transformations such as Fourmungousaur, Humungoopsaur and Atomic-X
